title: Multiple Explicit MPC Controllers
text: Multiple explicit MPC controllers, 6 inputs, 4 outputs, {Block data type} sets data type of manipulated variables; {Cell Array of Explicit MPC Controllers} sets the candidate controllers cell array of explicitMPC, {Cell Array of Initial Controller States} sets the initial state cell array of mpcstate, {Measured disturbances} adds measured disturbance input port, {External manipulated variable} adds external manipulated variable input, {Status of piecewise affine function evaluation} adds evaluation status output port, {Region number of evaluated piecewise affine function} adds region number output port, {Estimated controller states} adds estimated states output port, {Use custom state estimation instead of using the built-in Kalman filter} uses custom state estimate input port and {Inherit sample time} sets the inherit block sample time from parent. Values come from the instance.
